name: Fluval FX6 High-Performance Canister Filter
description: Powerful canister filter suitable for aquariums up to 400 gallons. Features multi-stage filtration with easy prime technology, quick-connect hoses, and whisper-quiet operation. Ideal for large freshwater and saltwater setups.

name: Eheim Jäger Aquarium Heater 300W
description: Precision German-engineered submersible heater with shatterproof borosilicate glass. Accurate temperature control within 0.5°C with automatic shutoff. Suitable for aquariums from 100 to 300 liters.

name: ADA Amazonia Aquasoil Powder 9L
description: Premium nutrient-rich aquasoil from ADA, formulated for planted aquariums. The powder version is ideal for foreground carpeting plants. Lowers pH and buffers water parameters to create optimal growing conditions.

name: AquaClear 110 Power Filter
description: Versatile hang-on-back power filter with fully customizable media basket. Features 500 GPH flow rate, adjustable flow control, and self-priming pump. Perfect for large freshwater aquariums up to 110 gallons.

name: Chihiros WRGB II Pro LED Light 90cm
description: High-output LED lighting system with WiFi control and programmable sunrise/sunset simulation. Full spectrum RGBW LEDs deliver 120+ PAR at 60cm depth. Ideal for high-light planted tanks and demanding carpet plants.

name: Tropica Growth Juice CO2 Booster 500ml
description: Liquid carbon supplement for planted aquariums. Provides an accessible source of carbon for aquatic plants. Safe for fish and invertebrates when used as directed. Alternative to pressurized CO2 systems.

name: Seachem Pristine 500ml
description: Natural biological water treatment that reduces sludge, detritus, and organic waste. Contains beneficial bacteria that break down waste at the source. Improves water clarity and reduces maintenance frequency.

name: Oase Biomaster Thermo 600 Canister Filter
description: Premium canister filter with integrated heater for a clean in-tank look. Self-priming with pre-filter for easy cleaning. Suitable for aquariums up to 250 liters with adjustable flow control.

name: UNS Delta 60 Aquarium 60x30x36cm
description: Ultra-clear low-iron glass aquarium with beveled edges and starphire glass. Rimless design for a clean, modern look. Approximately 64 liters with 6mm thick glass. Includes leveling mat.

name: Hanna Instruments pH Tester HI98103
description: Portable pH tester with replaceable electrode and automatic calibration. Easy-to-read LCD display with 0.01 pH resolution. Ideal for freshwater and saltwater aquarium testing.
